name: Into the Mist
source: Welcome to Eldergrove – a small town shrouded in mist, where magic weaves through everyday life. Following the trail of your best friend, Mistral, you arrive with a seemingly simple task: selling herbs to the townsfolk. But Eldergrove is not as peaceful as it appears…
